sources.title: welf1003: Topic 7 Microskills 3 – responding
sources.technique: Listen for meaning as well as the client’s words, and respond to discrepancies or new perspectives the client has offered rather than simply repeating their account.

sources.title: Reflective Listening
sources.technique: Use a complex reflection as a statement that tentatively guesses at the client’s meaning or what they have not yet said, rather than only restating their words.

sources.title: Reflecting & Listening Skills | counseling.education
sources.technique: Deepen a reflection by integrating the client’s content with their feelings and the personal meaning it may hold, instead of reflecting content alone.
